decisions.reason: The aloe vera facial care line has its own page and several models, signaling continued strategic focus and low risk of being dropped.
The serum is close to the established offer and has only been on the market about two years, so it is too early to drop.
The cleansing milk aligns with the firm's core natural skincare range and needs more time to build presence.
As a recent launch close to the existing portfolio, the cleansing oil should be given more time before any withdrawal decision.
